excerpts.excerpt: If this brings the target's [Armour|Armour] value to 0, their [Armour|Armour] is Fully Broken for 12 seconds, or 4 seconds for players.
On top of not benefitting from [Armour], non-player targets with Fully Broken [Armour] take 20% increased [Physical] damage from [Hit|Hits].
Bleeding deals an extra 100% damage while the target is moving, or if the Bleeding is [Aggravate|Aggravated].
Chill [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] depends on the Chilling damage dealt relative to the target's [AilmentThreshold|Elemental Ailment Threshold], with a minimum of 30% and a default maximum of 50%.
However, Chills smaller than 30% will be ignored, so small [Hit|Hits] can fail to Chill.
Damage from [Bleeding] and [Poison] bypasses Energy Shield to remove Life directly.
Rapidly [ESRecharge|Recharges] if you don't lose Energy Shield for a short time.
Each instance of Flammability has its own independent duration, lasting 8 seconds by default.
Multiple instances of Flammability stack, raising the chance for [Hit|Hits] to [Ignite] the target up to 100%.
The base [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] of Flammability is 1% chance to Ignite the target for every 5% of the target's [AilmentThreshold|Ailment Threshold] dealt as [Fire] damage.
Targets become Frozen when they reach 100% [Freeze] buildup.
Ignite is an [Ailments|Ailment] that deals [Fire] damage over time, and lasts for 4 seconds by default.
The chance for a [Hit] to Ignite a target is determined by the total [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] of [Flammability] on the target, including the amount added by that [Hit].
15% less Slow effect on Magic monsters
30% less Slow effect on Rare monsters
50% less Slow effect on Unique monsters
